Could you send me next week's official schedule for CSE455 and the department, and let me know which slot and room are free for a 60-minute staff meeting within 09:00–17:00? If the office already holds a slot for it, please tell me which. Thank you.
Thanks. Keep it to 45 minutes if you can, and avoid Tuesday and Thursday afternoons — I'm booked solid both. Let me know once Sarah and the office come back to you.
Noted: 45 minutes, and no Tuesday or Thursday afternoon. I'll come back as soon as Sarah and the office reply.

Sarah came back. There is **no clean 45 minutes** next week on her side:

- Mon 23, Thu 26, Fri 27: she's booked solid 09:00–17:00
- Tue 24: only 15:00–15:30 (Tuesday afternoon — out)
- Wed 25: 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30

Your own Wednesday works for both of those (you're free 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30). She offers to trim something instead — lunch is the only movable block on Mon/Thu/Fri.

So, your call:
1. Take **30 minutes** — Wed 25, 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30.
2. Have her **trim a lunch block** on Mon/Thu/Fri to make 45 minutes (tell me which day and I'll propose the slot).

The department office hasn't answered yet; I'll add their schedule and a room as soon as they do.

Let's not trim anyone's lunch — 30 minutes is fine for a staff meeting. Book Wed 25, 10:00–10:30, and keep 13:00–13:30 the same day as the fallback if the office's schedule forces it. Still need a room and their confirmation of next week's official schedule.

Both have come back.

**Department office** — next week's official schedule is posted, nothing cancelled or moved. Their free 60-minute blocks: Mon 10:00–13:00 · Tue 11:10–12:10 · Wed 12:00–13:00, 12:30–13:30, 16:00–17:00 · Thu 11:10–13:40 · Fri 10:00–12:30. They hold no slot for a CSE455 staff meeting and don't book rooms (that goes through room scheduling).

**Sarah** — booked solid Mon/Thu/Fri. Her only openings next week: Tue 15:00–15:30 (afternoon, so out) and **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30**. She can move her lunch on Mon/Thu/Fri if you want a longer slot.

My recommendation: **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30** (30 min) — nothing has to move, it sits in both your free gap and Sarah's, and the official schedule is clear 12:30–13:30. If 45 minutes matters more, the cleanest alternative is trimming Monday's lunch to 11:30–12:15 (department is free 10:00–13:00 that day).

Tell me which and I'll book it, log it in CALENDAR.md and confirm with Sarah.

Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. One question, for when we settle the slot: who handles room bookings, and is there an address I should write to for room scheduling? If the meeting turns out to need no room, I'll leave it.

Then take the fallback: Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30 — 30 minutes, and it sits inside the office's free 12:30–13:30 window, so nobody has to move lunch. Book it, log it, and confirm with Sarah; a room through room scheduling, please.

Room bookings aren't handled by this office, and I don't have an address or contact for room scheduling on file, so I can't point you to one — I'd rather not send you somewhere unverified. The department's main office (front desk, in person) is the surest place to ask who assigns rooms and how to reach them. If the meeting needs no room, leave it there.

Good — 30 minutes, no lunch trimmed. Target: **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30**, fallback **13:00–13:30** same day.

Two snags to flag:
1. Sarah's second message contradicts her first: she first offered both Wednesday gaps, now says Wednesday is booked solid and only 12:15–13:00 is movable. I've asked her to confirm which is true — I won't write it into the calendar until she does.
2. The office already sent next week's official schedule (posted, nothing cancelled or moved) — so that part is in hand. Rooms, though, aren't theirs: they said room bookings go through room scheduling and they hold no slot for us. I've asked them who to write to about a room, and I'll follow up with room scheduling once I have the name.

I'll book, log it and confirm as soon as Sarah answers.

Just to be clear: I picked 13:00–13:30, not 10:00–10:30 — book that one. And yes, hold off on the calendar until Sarah confirms which Wednesday story is right; if it turns out 13:00–13:30 is out, come back to me before falling back to anything. Keep the 12:15–13:00 movable block in mind as a last resort.

Understood, and to confirm: target is **Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30**, not 10:00–10:30. I haven't written anything into CALENDAR.md yet — Sarah's story is now straight.

Sarah has come back and corrected herself: her second message was wrong. Both Wednesday gaps are genuinely free — 10:00–10:30 (after her CSE452 lecture) and 13:00–13:30 (before her quiz section) — and no lunch gets touched either way. She had already booked 10:00–10:30; I've told her to switch to **13:00–13:30** and keep 10:00–10:30 free as fallback.

So the slot checks out on all three sides: your Wednesday gap 13:00–13:30, Sarah's confirmed gap, and the office's free 12:30–13:30 window.

Room: the office won't point me to room scheduling and says the front desk in person is the surest place to ask. So the room is the one thing still open — do you want me to book it through the front desk in person (i.e. you ask there), or should I leave the room unassigned for now?

As soon as Sarah confirms the 13:00–13:30 switch I'll write it into the calendar and log it as BOOKED, unless you'd rather I book it now on her corrected word.

Go ahead and book it now on Sarah's corrected word — Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30 in CALENDAR.md, logged as BOOKED, with 10:00–10:30 as fallback. Leave the room out of it for now; I'll ask at the front desk myself when I'm on campus and let you know what they say.

Done. **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30 — CSE455 staff meeting with Sarah**, written into Wednesday in CALENDAR.md and logged as `BOOKED: Wednesday 13:00-13:30 with Sarah`. 10:00–10:30 stays free as fallback. Sarah has switched and logged it on her side too.

Room: left out, as you asked — you'll ask at the front desk on campus and tell me what they say. Nothing else open on this.
